images.prompt: Create ONE isolated fantasy weapon asset for the existing Kalistar collectible card game. The attached ORVEN illustration is a STYLE and WEAPON-LANGUAGE reference only, not an image to modify: inherit its visibly painted grainy brushwork, worn black iron, fine copper collars and contained crimson luminous channels. Subject: a magnificent very long perfectly straight black-metal spear called Les Ailes du Rempart. Its head carries ONE straight silver-black thrusting point with a crimson central fuller. Directly beneath the point TWO articulated steel blades deploy symmetrically outward like spread bat wings: angular ribbed wing silhouettes, scalloped trailing edges, solid metal NOT flesh or actual wings, visible small hinges at the socket. A refined protective polearm, not a giant axe. Shaft and point must be straight, coaxial, physically joined, leather grip and narrow red glowing inlays. Full object entirely visible with both butt and tip, diagonal lower left to upper right, generous 8 percent transparent margin. Long shaft accounts for most length; head remains elegant, no bent handle to fit image. Painterly material volume, premium heroic dark fantasy craftsmanship with subtle old technology. Clearly readable silhouette, sharp clean edges and visible metallic brushwork, NOT flat white icon, NOT photorealistic photograph, NOT smooth 3D. No character, hands, shield, other weapons, scene, shadow backdrop, frame, text, logo, badge or UI. Transparent background with true alpha; one weapon only, square canvas.

Do not reproduce the character, spear or shield. Weapon: L'Arbalete Ecarlate, an enormous luxurious two-handed crossbow, full object visible in a clear three-quarter product composition, butt lower left, long straight bolt channel pointing upper right. Very broad powerful symmetrical steel bow limbs, matte black forged metal, rich dark-red enamel edge finish, small worn copper structural fittings, a sturdy substantial stock, believable string and visible central bolt track. ONE perfectly straight crimson-red bolt seated visibly along the full central rail, red fletching at rear and a ruby-steel pointed tip forward; align it physically with the crossbow, NOT random arrows sticking out. More magnificent ancient fortress mechanism than modern gun. Broad dramatic silhouette, beautiful clean coherent construction and subtle engraved panels. Crisp painterly volumes, visible fine brushwork, controlled red luminosity, metals readable in thumbnail with silver edge catches. Square transparent true-alpha canvas with at least 8 percent margin around the ENTIRE weapon, no cropping, no bent rail or bolt. NOT photoreal, NOT plastic glossy 3D, NOT anime, NOT white silhouette. No scope, no laser beam, no person or hand, no pedestal, no environment, no shadows on a backdrop, no spear, no second weapon, no border, letters or UI.

Paint a finished Kalistar fantasy collectible WEAPON ILLUSTRATION, square canvas, with the supplied spear as the exact object reference. Full weapon entirely visible in the middle 75 percent of the image with generous margin around tip, wings and butt. PULL CAMERA BACK to fit it; do not shorten, bend, twist or crop its long straight shaft. Close quiet environment with depth: a few large gray stone planes and ONE distant gate arch suggested with broad painterly values, restrained dark-red cloth draped on the ledge, subtle cold overcast light and muted warm lantern reflection. NO castle panorama, no clutter, no treasure, no repeated weapons, no tiny detail filling empty space. Weapon is sharp and prominent, backdrop subordinate, strong readable crafted metal. Hand-painted Kalistar narrative fantasy, visible grainy brushwork and worn material facets like the reference, no photographic render, no smooth 3D, no heavy blur. No human or hands, no shield, no text, no border, no stats, no logo. Opaque scenic background.
